name: Photopea
description_en:
Photopea is a browser image editor for layered raster and vector work, using PSD as its main editable document format. It opens many image, design and RAW formats and provides layers, masks, smart objects, adjustments, paths, retouching and export tools. Its documented core editing runs locally on the user’s hardware rather than requiring photo uploads.

It fits users who need detailed image editing or a PSD-oriented handoff without installing a desktop application. Preserve the editable PSD separately from delivery exports and check fidelity on representative files. Free use is explicitly permitted; a fixed-term Premium account is optional. Browser execution and free access do not establish an open-source platform license or independently verified compatibility with every imported feature.
description_zh:
Photopea是用于分层位图/矢量工作的浏览器图像编辑器，以PSD为主要可编辑文档格式，可打开多种图像、设计及RAW格式，并提供图层、蒙版、智能对象、调整、路径、修饰和导出。其文档中的核心编辑在用户设备运行，无需上传照片。

它适合无需安装桌面应用却需要精细编辑或PSD交接的用户。应分别保存可编辑PSD和交付输出，并用代表文件检查保真。条款明确允许免费使用，可选固定期限Premium。浏览器运行及免费访问不证明平台开源，也不证明每个导入功能都独立验证兼容。

core_features.explanation_en: Save an editable document as PSD; export JPG/PNG/SVG/PDF and other delivery formats separately.
core_features.explanation_zh: 以PSD保存可编辑文档，另行导出JPG/PNG/SVG/PDF等交付格式。

core_features.explanation_en: The introduction/privacy page says opened files are processed on-device; optional cloud storage has separate explicit access.
core_features.explanation_zh: 入门/隐私页表示打开文件在设备处理，可选云存储需另行授予访问。

core_features.explanation_en: Record/apply actions and load/export ATN sets; healing/patch tools replace areas using surrounding or chosen content.
core_features.explanation_zh: 录制/应用动作并加载/导出ATN集合，修复/补片利用周围或选定内容替换区域。

pricing.source_snapshot_zh: 编辑器免费使用，可一次性购买固定期限Premium，到期回Free；未建立当前数值价及AI额度。

sections.title_en: A document editor with both raster and vector tools
sections.title_zh: 兼有位图及矢量工具的文档编辑器
sections.en:
The [introduction](https://www.photopea.com/learn/) describes simple resizing through layered illustration and photographic work. The homepage lists PSD opening/saving, masks, layer styles, smart objects, channels, paths, RAW adjustments and many import formats. Those are vendor capability statements, not proof that a complex third-party document round-trips without changes.

Editorial example: open a supplied PSD, adjust a product image/text and export a web banner. Check fonts, layer effects, blending and linked/embedded assets against the approved source. A raster export may be perfectly suitable for a banner while being unsuitable as the editable handoff. A large screen, pointing device and keyboard are recommended even though the application can run on smaller devices; memory/CPU/GPU capability affects practical file handling.
sections.zh:
[入门](https://www.photopea.com/learn/)覆盖从改尺寸到分层插画和照片处理，首页列出PSD打开/保存、蒙版、图层样式、智能对象、通道、路径、RAW调整及多种格式。这些是厂商能力表述，不证明复杂第三方文档往返无变化。

编辑示例：打开客户PSD，调整商品图/文字，再导出网页横幅；应对照获批源文件检查字体、效果、混合及链接/嵌入素材。位图可能适合网页交付，却不适合当可编辑交接。即使小设备可运行，指南仍建议大屏、指针设备和键盘；实际处理大文件取决于内存/CPU/GPU。

sections.title_en: Opening location and save target change the result
sections.title_zh: 打开位置及保存目标会改变行为
sections.en:
The [Open and Save guide](https://www.photopea.com/learn/opening-saving) uses File → Open, clipboard paste or drag-and-drop. Dropping into an existing document’s canvas inserts a Smart Object layer; dropping into the document tab bar opens a separate document. Imported formats are represented internally as a PSD document. Save as PSD preserves the editable structure, while Export As creates the delivery format and allows output dimensions to be set.

File → Save can replace an original local file in supported modern browsers; it can also write back to the connected cloud, a Smart Object or an API destination. Therefore, choose Save as/export and the intended target deliberately when preserving an original is important. Do not assume every Save creates a new independent file. The privacy page warns that closing without saving loses the work; this is not an automatic server backup service.
sections.zh:
[打开/保存指南](https://www.photopea.com/learn/opening-saving)支持File → Open、剪贴板粘贴及拖放。拖入已有文档画布会插入智能对象图层，拖入文档标签栏则另开文档，导入格式在内部表示为PSD。Save as PSD保留结构，Export As生成交付格式并设置输出尺寸。

在受支持现代浏览器中File → Save可覆盖本地原文件，也可写回连接的云端、智能对象或API目标。因此需要保留原件时应明确选择另存/导出及目标，不能假定每次Save都生成独立新文件。隐私页提醒未保存就关闭会丢失工作，这不是自动服务器备份服务。

sections.title_en: Retouching invents replacement pixels; actions repeat choices
sections.title_zh: 修饰生成替代像素，动作复用既定操作
sections.en:
The [Smart Tools guide](https://www.photopea.com/learn/bt-smart) explains Spot Healing: paint an unwanted area and release to replace it using surrounding content. Healing Brush and Patch additionally choose a source, adapting it to the destination. Inspect edges, repeated textures and important product/face details; a plausible fill is not evidence of the original hidden content. The guide’s timing/comparison claims were not benchmarked.

For repeated work, Window → Actions exposes sets, actions and steps. Record starts/stops capturing steps; Apply runs the action on the current document. The [action guide](https://www.photopea.com/learn/actions) supports loading and exporting .ATN sets. This documents replay, not universal compatibility with every Photoshop action or unattended folder processing. Validate the action on varied images, especially where selections, coordinates or dimensions differ.
sections.zh:
[智能工具指南](https://www.photopea.com/learn/bt-smart)说明Spot Healing涂过目标后用周围内容替换，Healing Brush及Patch还需选择来源并适配目标。应检查边缘、重复纹理及关键商品/人脸细节，合理填充不证明原来被遮挡内容；指南中的时间/比较未跑基准。

重复工作可用Window → Actions，分集合、动作、步骤，Record开始/停止录制，Apply在当前文档执行。[动作指南](https://www.photopea.com/learn/actions)支持加载/导出.ATN集合，说明的是重放，不保证兼容每个Photoshop动作或无人值守文件夹批处理。应以不同图片验证，尤其选择区、坐标或尺寸变化时。

sections.title_zh: 免费编辑器与固定期限Premium
sections.en:
The combined [Terms/Privacy page](https://www.photopea.com/privacy.html) explicitly allows anyone to use the editor for any purpose without paying for operations that are not pay-gated. Users can sell their own work without paying Photopea a share or requiring attribution. Premium is described as a one-time purchase for a chosen term, for example 90 days, after which the account returns to Free; this is not a recurring subscription claim.

Current numeric Premium prices and the precise paid feature/AI allowance matrix were not visible in the pages read, so no amount or unlimited AI quota is asserted. Free access and a permissive right to use the application do not transfer rights to third-party source files, fonts, photos or the application’s source code. Generated-content and external AI-specific conditions remain a separate unresolved question.
sections.zh:
合并的[条款/隐私页](https://www.photopea.com/privacy.html)明确允许任何人为任何目的免费使用未要求付费的操作，用户可出售自己的作品，无需分成或署名。Premium描述为选定期限的一次性购买，如90天，到期回Free，不据此声称循环订阅。

实读页未显示当前Premium数值价格及具体付费功能/AI额度矩阵，因此不填金额或无限AI额度。免费访问及宽松应用使用权不转让第三方源文件、字体、图片或应用源码权利，生成内容及外部AI专属条件仍是独立未决问题。

sections.title_en: Local editing, optional clouds and account data are different
sections.title_zh: 本地编辑、可选云端及账户数据不同
sections.en:
The privacy page says core opened files stay on-device; the introduction says editing can continue offline after loading the site. Optional cloud connectors explicitly read from/write to the selected storage directly, with access limited to allowed files. Using a cloud source is therefore different from editing only a local file. Account login stores name/email/preferences and payment records, with stated deletion after six months without login or by request.

These are vendor policy statements, not a network audit. The homepage also advertises generative replacement; the pages read did not separately establish its model processing path, credit limits or retention, so the local-core claim is not generalized into a verified zero-transmission assurance for every optional AI/integration. No document, cloud permission, action, AI request, saved PSD or export was executed.
sections.zh:
隐私页表示核心打开文件留在设备，入门称载入网站后可离线继续编辑；可选云连接直接读取/写入指定存储，并限于获准文件，因此云来源与纯本地编辑不同。登录账户会存姓名/邮件/偏好及付款记录，并声明6个月不登录或按请求删除。

这是厂商政策，不是网络审计。首页也宣传生成式替换，但实读页未单独建立模型处理路径、点数及保留，所以不把本地核心声明扩大成每个可选AI/集成均已核实零传输。未执行文档、云权限、动作、AI、PSD保存或导出。
